root_cause: kuna-analysis loadimage_object.rs builds its memory map only from PT_LOAD segments; ET_REL .o files have no program headers, so the map is empty and every function fails with 'Unable to load N bytes'.

decisions.question: Is closing this gap a small single option-gated decompiler Action/Rule, or a large loader-infrastructure feature?
decisions.justification: The gap lives entirely in the kuna-analysis loader tier (loadimage_object.rs), upstream of the kuna-decomp S1-S9 pass pipeline; it is structurally not an Action/Rule and cannot be gated like kuna_loweredswitch.rs. Reaching angr parity needs three pieces of new loader infrastructure: (1) lay out SHF_ALLOC sections at synthetic non-overlapping addresses to replace the empty PT_LOAD-derived map, (2) parse and apply .rela.* relocations, (3) rebase/bind local+global symbols. Skipping any (e.g. mapping sections but not relocating) yields degenerate output where every call/global-ref targets 0. This is new infrastructure + structural edits to a ported-core loader file beyond a single gated early-return, satisfying Hard rule 7 LARGE on multiple counts; route through a [PROPOSAL] draft PR.
